plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Reduce exposure to downtrending QQQ and SMH.
Trim CRWD to reduce single name concentration.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
A significant cash buffer will be maintained.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, leading to lower expected drawdowns. Returns will be modest but more stable.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) to reduce overall leverage and meet the mandate.
Reduce QQQI to 20% to comply with single name concentration limits.
Trim SMH and CRWD to reduce concentration and exposure to downtrends.
Buy NOW, a strong scanner setup, to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a moderate cash buffer.
Total adds will not exceed total trims plus the cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) to lean into growth.
Add to CRWD, a strong performer, and buy NOW and PLTR, top scanner setups.
This plan concentrates in high-scoring setups and uses leverage for stretch growth.
A smaller cash buffer will be maintained, with strict stop discipline.
This approach raises both upside potential and drawdown risk.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of significantly higher drawdown potential and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) to zero.
Increase QQQI to 30% to prioritize income generation.
Sell high-beta single names like CRWD and SMH.
Trim QQQ to further reduce growth exposure.
This plan focuses on steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
A cash buffer will be maintained for stability.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes income and low drawdown over growth, rotating into income/covered-call ETFs. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
